<translate>
<!--T:7-->
'''Rage Scream''' is the roar of the Great Ape. It is one of the three techniques you get while you are in the '''Oozaru''' or '''Golden Oozaru''' form: for 3 seconds it repeatedly damages and pushes back everything around you.
</translate>

<translate>
== Getting it == <!--T:8-->

<!--T:9-->
No master teaches Rage Scream and it has no TP cost. While you are in the Oozaru or Golden Oozaru form, your first three technique slots are replaced with [[Special:MyLanguage/Mouth Blast|Mouth Blast]], '''Oozaru Slam''' and Rage Scream. They are added temporarily if you don't own them, and your normal slots come back when you leave the form. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Saiyan|Saiyan]] for the Oozaru forms and [[Special:MyLanguage/Fake Moon|Fake Moon]] for one way to trigger them.
</translate>

<translate>
== How it works == <!--T:10-->

<!--T:11-->
Press the technique's slot key to roar. For '''3 seconds''', everything around you is repeatedly damaged and pushed back. Its damage scales with your Strike Damage (SKP).

<!--T:12-->
After using it, all your evasion techniques share a short lockout (the technique's duration + 3 seconds).
</translate>

<translate>
== Upgrades == <!--T:13-->

<!--T:14-->
Like every evasion technique, Rage Scream gains experience when you use it, which can be spent on '''duration''' (+2.5% per level, up to +50%) and '''cooldown'''.
</translate>
